# CryptoWebBuild Agency

> Elite AI Automation & Web3 Infrastructure Agency. We turn slow, outdated websites into highly authoritative lead-generation machines by building custom AI Agent infrastructure, AI Community Guardians, and Web3 Growth Funnels.

## Business Details
- **Name:** CryptoWebBuild
- **Founder:** Sagor Ahamed (Senior Web3 Developer & Architect)
- **Website:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com](https://cryptowebbuild.com)
- **Contact Email:** [hello@cryptowebbuild.com](mailto:hello@cryptowebbuild.com)

## Target Audience & Niche Focus
- Web3 & Crypto Projects (Token Presales, Meme Coins, DApps, NFT Marketplaces)
- Founders and SaaS Owners looking for automated growth
- High-Growth Businesses needing AI Agents

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Custom AI Agent Infrastructure:** We build, train, and deploy elite AI agents to move fast and dominate your niche.
- **AI Community Guardians:** 24/7 AI Guardians instantly answer investor questions based on your Whitepaper, eliminating fear and doubt.
- **Web3 Growth Funnels:** Custom dApp UIs, token landing pages, presale flows, and wallet integrations.
- **Custom OpenClaw & AI Workflow Automation:** Build, configure, and deploy intelligent OpenClaw AI agents.
- **ClickRunClaw:** Our flagship AI SaaS product designed to automate web research, data extraction, and B2B lead generation.

## Technical Capabilities & Philosophy
- **Architecture:** Static-First, Headless CMS, and Client-Side rendering.
- **Performance:** Fast-loading, static-first builds with strong Core Web Vitals.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS (Glassmorphism/Neomorphism UI), Solana Web3.js, Ethers.js, Cloudflare CDN.
- **Security:** Zero-database static architecture to prevent SQL injection and enhance global distribution.
